title: Purani Asam Buranji Ed. 2nd
author: Pandit Hemchandra Goswami
description: Standard scholarly edition of ancient chronicles compiled by Pandit Hemchandra Goswami for the Kamarupa Anusandhana Samiti, preserving archaic manuscript records of early Tai monarchs, territorial expansion, court titles, and administrative treaties.

sentences.text_roman: phaa tai khyaa tii mroeng chau tsaw

sentences.free_translation_en: The ancient Tai chronicles record the lineage of the heavenly kings.
sentences.free_translation_as: প্ৰাচীন টাই বুৰঞ্জীত স্বৰ্গীয় ৰজাসকলৰ বংশাৱলী সংৰক্ষিত হৈ আছে।
sentences.speaker: Pandit Hemchandra Goswami (Pioneering Scholar)
sentences.notes: Opening formula of Purani Asam Buranji.

sentences.free_translation_as: স্বৰ্গদেৱে দেশৰ কেন্দ্ৰস্থলত নিজৰ ৰাজধানী স্থাপন কৰিলে।

sentences.free_translation_en: The Tai clans cultivating along the river paddies secured abundant rice.

sentences.speaker: Pandit Hemchandra Goswami
sentences.notes: Agricultural sustenance described in ancient puthis.
